column6: My king …… in his reed marshes. He …… in the silent reed marshes. He extended his house over a huge reed marsh, over a …… reed marsh. Its …… is green; he has built …… by the water. He called his city the shrine @wSN{Urim}. In his city, the lord of the long days, @wDN{Suen}, founded a dwelling-place. In @wSN{Urim}, the city chosen in his heart, bull-like the house gives praise.

My king's splendid place is indeed an august place, a most precious place. @wDN{Suen} …… his beloved city, the shrine @wSN{Urim}, the pure divine powers …… his city. My king …… the holy dais. Lord @wDN{Ašimbabbar} …….

@q[,Suen]{“O @wDN{Nanna}, @wDN{Nanna}, where have you tended your cows, Lord @wDN{Ašimbabbar}?”} @q[Suen,]{“In the chosen city, the shrine of my heart which I have founded in joy like @wSN{Aratta} ……. In my shrine @wSN{Urim} I have tended my cows.”} @q[,Suen]{“First-born son of @wDN{Enlil}, where have you tended the people, Lord @wDN{Ašimbabbar}?”}

@q[Suen,]{“In the chosen city, the shrine of my heart which I have founded in joy, like @wSN{Aratta} ……; in my @wTN{E-mud-kura} I have tended my cows.”} @q[,Suen]{“First-born son of @wDN{Enlil}, where have you tended the people, Lord @wDN{Ašimbabbar}?”} @q[Suen,]{“In a place founded on a good day and given a good name, in the place chosen in my heart, my @wTN{E-mud-kura}, I, @wDN{Ašimbabbar}, have tended my cows.”} @q[,Suen]{“First-born son of Enlil, where have you tended the people, Lord @wDN{Ašimbabbar}?”} @q[Suen,]{“In a place founded on a good day and given a good name, in the place chosen in my heart, my @wTN{E-mud-kura}, I, @wDN{Ašimbabbar}, have tended my cows.”} @q[,Suen]{“King of the holy cattle-pen, where have you tended your cows, youthful, noble shepherd?”} @q[Suen,]{“In the meadow where I have built a dais for my shrine @wSN{Urim} and have let date palms grow as in the land of @wGN{Dilmun} -- there in its holy reedbeds I have tended my cows.”} @q[,Suen]{“First-born son of Enlil, where have you tended the people, youthful, noble shepherd?”} @q[Suen,]{“In the meadow where I have built a dais for my shrine @wSN{Urim} and have let date palms grow as in the land of @wGN{Dilmun} -- there in its holy reedbeds I have tended my cows.”}
